title: Blister agent
summary: Lewisite mortar rounds hit a position. A soldier without a suit is still lying in the contaminated area, burning and coughing. You are masked and suited. The CBRN setting is enabled on this server.
objectives: Get him out of the contaminated area at once (every second there adds lewisite)
Dimercaprol IM removes lewisite from the body (an IV push does nothing)
Wash his eyes before the blindness becomes permanent
Watch the airway (inflammation) and replace blood leaking from damaged capillaries
